info.name: Portfolio Service API
info.description:
Ready-to-run Postman collection for portfolio-service.

## Quick start
1. Start the service on port **8087** (default).
2. Import `Portfolio-Service.postman_collection.json` and `Local.postman_environment.json`.
3. Select the **Portfolio Service — Local** environment.
4. Send any request in **01 - All Endpoints**, or run a **Runner** folder via Collection Runner.

## Auth
All `/api/*` calls require header `X-User-Id` (set from collection variable `userId`).

## Variables
- `baseUrl` — default `http://localhost:8087`
- `userId` — demo user for scoping data
- `ticker`, `fromDate`, `toDate` — shared filters
- `transactionId` / `sellTransactionId` / `runId` — filled by create/trigger scripts

## Runners
Use Postman Collection Runner on folders A–E to simulate end-to-end test cases.
